name: Waiting for Players
description: The six-person cast gathers at Wilson's pawnshop.

name: Role Assignment
description: Each player receives one unique role.

name: The Pawnshop Gathering
description: Introduce your public identity and hear Holmes's opening questions.
fallback_message: I am Sherlock Holmes's unseen observer. The Red-Headed League has vanished, but its four hours may have hidden a crime. Introduce yourselves in English, keep your private motives concealed, and ask the host when you need a lead.

name: Search the Pawnshop
description: Search the shop, office, basement, and nearby street for evidence.

name: Baker Street Deduction
description: Compare the contract, the tunnel evidence, and each person's story.

name: Final Accusation
description: Vote for the person most responsible for the fraud.

name: The Case Reconstructed
description: The host explains the advertisement, the tunnel, and every character's fate.
